result.reason: The redline adds the Customer assignment carve-out, but it does not prohibit Contractor assignments to a Customer competitor, as required by the preferred position. It also does not implement the fallback’s mutual successor-assignment right with written notice. The added subcontractor-responsibility language is outside the assignment/change-of-control ask and changes substantive obligations unnecessarily. In addition, allowing partial assignments and assignments in connection with any reorganization or business-unit sale is broader than the stated Customer carve-out.
